note.question: What role does switching from low to high prices play in volatile markets?
note.overview: Traditional monopoly pricing assumes sellers have full information about consumer valuations. The model considers monopoly pricing under limited information when a seller only knows the mean, variance, and support of the valuation distribution. The objective is to maximize expected revenue by selecting the optimal fixed price.
